answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 2769 Country: India Title: If somebody is saving money for the marriage of his daughter and son. Is zakat payable for this money which he is saving.now u may ask why he has to save money because it takes lot of money for the marrige? Question: If somebody is saving money for the marriage of his daughter and son. Is zakat payable for this money which he is saving.now u may ask why he has to save money because it takes lot of money for the marrige? Answer ID: 2769 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 117/118=L) When the amount is in your possession and you did not spend it in marriage, then you have to pay zakah incurred on the amount, provided you possess the wealth equal to nisab (prescribed amount) of zakah for a complete lunar year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
